response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in the telescopes table (grouped by telescopes.observstation); observatories with no telescopes are not included.
An observatory's share is its telescope count divided by the total number of telescopes, as a fraction (0-1) rather than a percentage.
The average share across all observatories is the simple mean of the per-observatory shares (not a count-weighted mean).
